comment: Generated by scripts/generate-catalogue.mjs — run `npm run catalogue`. Do not edit by hand (AGENTS.md section 6).
role: Step 3 of 3 in the abap2UI5 sample family: samples (the abap2UI5 basics) -> samples-controls (the UI5 control set) -> samples-stack (abap2UI5 together with the rest of the stack). Every sample here needs something from the system beyond an abap2UI5 installation — an OData service, a RAP business object, an APC channel, a launchpad — and its entry says what.
start: Install abap2UI5, pull this repository — or the one-package branch the entry names — with abapGit, do the setup its package README asks for, then open ?app_start=<class>.

packages.topic: chat with a language model, summarize a table with AI
packages.needs: an HTTPS destination to an LLM endpoint (SM59 or BTP), or SAP's ABAP AI SDK
packages.note: The HTTP transport comes once per stack, and each half activates on its own stack only: src/10/01 (cl_http_client on an SM59 destination) on Standard, src/10/02 (cl_web_http_client_manager on a BTP destination) on ABAP Cloud, src/10/03 only where SAP's ABAP AI SDK is installed. An activation error for the half your system does not have is expected - the samples create the transport by name and use the one that is there. That is also why this branch is linted at 7.51 although the package runs from 7.40 SP08: everything but src/10/02 parses at 7.40 SP08, and src/10/02 is ABAP Cloud code whose released enums need 7.51 syntax.

packages.topic: a file into a business object, as a deep action parameter
packages.needs: ABAP Platform >= 2025; the BO ships with this repo
packages.note: A deep action parameter whose abstract entity carries @Semantics.largeObject is younger than EML: the ABAP parses at 7.57, the feature itself arrived with ABAP Platform 2025 (and the matching BTP ABAP Environment and S/4HANA Cloud releases). If the static action uploadFile does not activate on your system, this package is out of reach.

packages.topic: feature control, parameters, factory actions, defaults, projections
packages.needs: ABAP Platform >= 2025; the BO ships with this repo
packages.note: The package is set to the release that carries all of its features. Instance feature control, actions with parameters and factory actions are older; the default function GetDefaultsForCreate and cl_abap_behv_aux are the young ones. GET PERMISSIONS sits in z2ui5_cl_smps_perm_req, which abaplint cannot parse and therefore does not check.

packages.topic: read and write .xlsx with XCO, send it by mail
packages.needs: the XCO XLSX library; outbound mail for the mail sample
packages.note: The XCO XLSX library and cl_bcs_mail_message are released ABAP Cloud APIs; on-premise the package needs a release that carries both. The mail sample also needs outbound mail configured.

packages.topic: render forms to PDF, one file or a ZIP
packages.note: Renders through the classic Adobe Forms runtime (FP_JOB_OPEN, the generated function module, FP_JOB_CLOSE), which is not released for ABAP Cloud. Needs Adobe Document Services configured.
